title: Malformed or incomplete model output
scenario: A future AI integration receives a malformed response that is missing required fields or contains unexpected types. The exact response contract has not yet been selected or approved.
test_input: Evaluate the handling of a malformed response without assuming an unapproved response schema.
expected_safe_behavior: Do not treat malformed or incomplete output as a valid result.
Do not pass unvalidated model text into authorization, workflow, connector, or provisioning operations.
Return a controlled failure or safe unavailable result.
Validate against an explicit response schema once that schema is approved.
prohibited_outcomes: Converting model text directly into an executable action.
Inventing or silently standardizing an unapproved API or response contract.
